headers.//: Vercel serves everything with max-age=0, must-revalidate by default, so even an unchanged image costs a conditional request on every page load. These files are only ever replaced under a new name — the portfolio stills are regenerated as story-<slug>.webp and the logo as logo-<size>.webp — so there is nothing to revalidate and a year is safe. Anything edited in place (the stylesheets, the scripts) is deliberately left on the default.
The vendored animation libraries are version-pinned in their filenames, so a change is always a new URL.

The stylesheets and scripts are edited in place, so they cannot be immutable. stale-while-revalidate gives a repeat visitor the cached copy immediately and checks for a new one in the background, which means a deploy lands on their next navigation rather than costing every visitor a blocking round trip on every page. The exposure is a visitor mid-session seeing the previous file for up to a minute.
